analysis.summaryJa: 最上級は複数候補から程度が最も高い一つを選ぶ形で、通常the＋-est／mostを用いる。副詞の最上級、一本の道や一日の中など同一物の状態変化ではtheを省ける場合、a most＋形容詞のmost＝very、比較範囲を示すinとofの区別まで扱う。
grammarPoints: 複数から一つを選ぶ最上級には通常theを付ける
短い語は-est、長い形容詞・副詞はmostを使う
同一物・同一人の内部で状態が最高になる地点や時はtheを省略できる
a most＋形容詞＋名詞のmostはveryの意味になる
in＋場所・集団、of＋数・候補全体で比較範囲を示す
visualEvidence: 複数のレベル塔から冠を載せた一本を選ぶ中央の最上級図
the＋-est／most、同一物の最高点ではthe省略可、most＝veryならtheなしの3区分
一本の道が場所により広さを変える右側の状態変化図
INの場所・集団ゲートとOFの数・並んだ集合ゲート
commonTraps: 通常の最上級からtheを落とす
副詞の最上級を-estだけで作ろうとする
most＝veryの前にtheを置いて最上級と誤解する
場所・集団の範囲にof、具体的候補集合にinを使う
比較範囲に比較対象自身を含めない

questions.prompt: Of all the delivery options, the morning courier is ------- fastest.

choices.B: most

questions.translationJa: すべての配送方法の中で、午前便が最も速いです。
questions.explanationJa: 複数候補から一つを選ぶ最上級fastestにはtheを付けます。

questions.prompt: Which of the four printers operates the most -------?

choices.B: quiet

questions.translationJa: 4台のプリンターのうち、どれが最も静かに動作しますか。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞quietlyの最上級はthe most quietlyです。

questions.prompt: The corridor is ------- near the emergency exit, where it expands to four meters.

choices.B: wider

questions.translationJa: その廊下は非常口付近で最も幅が広く、4メートルに広がります。
questions.explanationJa: 一本の廊下の内部で最高点を示すためtheを省いたwidestが自然です。
questions.focus: 同一物の最上級でthe省略

questions.prompt: Ms. Ito gave us a ------- useful explanation of the new policy.

choices.B: most

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは新方針について大変役立つ説明をしてくれました。

questions.prompt: This is the busiest station ------- the northern district.

questions.prompt: That was a most ------- response to a difficult complaint.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing how machines operate.

choices.B: This unit runs most efficient of all five units.
choices.C: This unit runs the more efficiently of all five units.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing one road at different points.

questions.explanationJa: 一本の道路の内部での最高程度なのでtheを省いたnarrowestが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using most to mean very.

choices.A: It was the most informative presentation, but no group is implied.
choices.B: It was a more most informative presentation.
choices.C: It was a most informative presentation.
choices.D: It was most an informative presentation.

questions.translationJa: それは大変有益な発表でした。
questions.explanationJa: a most informativeでmostはveryの意味となり、特定範囲の最上級ではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence naming a fixed set as the range.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence selecting an option by degree.

questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞reliableはthe most reliableで最上級を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about one employee’s changing performance.

choices.B: Rina works the faster early in the morning.
choices.C: Rina works most fastest early in the morning.

questions.explanationJa: 同じ人の一日の中での状態比較なので副詞fastestのtheを省けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a highly pleasant surprise.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence combining a superlative and a range.

choices.C: Which is the most accessible entrance in the building?
choices.D: Which entrance is the more accessible in the building?

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The river is deepest near the bridge."

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "That was a most considerate reply."

questions.translationJa: その返答はとても思いやりがありました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "It was a most unusual request."

choices.B: It was definitely the most unusual of several stated requests.

choices.D: The request was the only one received.
